label: 6. I've gotta come up with a way to overcome my f…

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I've gotta come up with a way to overcome my fear of starfish.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Got any foolproof methods?
So it's finally come to this, has it?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It has.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: There was a point in time when I hoped

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Anchor would grow tired of starfish and marine life,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: but I don't see that ever happening.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think changing my own perspective might prove to be faster.
This is a big decision.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You're the only person I can turn to for help.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If I tell Mast, she'll only leap at the opportunity to make fun of me even more.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Obviously,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: confiding in Anchor is out of the question.
Definitely.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So what do you think I should do?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If you can give me a roadmap

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: on how to get over my fear of starfish,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll follow it to the letter, I guarantee it.
How about some exposure therapy?
How about looking at pictures of starfish every day?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That kinda seems like

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'd be throwing myself in the deep end.
Then start with photos.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think I can manage that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll do some research and get back to you.
Helm doesn't respond for a while.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't do it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Even through the screen,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can just feel those nasty, squishy buggers.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't take it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Isn't there any other way?
How about positive reinforcement? Think good things about starfish.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That's not a bad idea either.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Let me give it a shot.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: But I don't have any positive memories about starfish.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: As soon as I think about them, I just get grossed out.
Hmm...
I look up some information about starfish.
There are these starfish keychains.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What?
How about we get a matching pair?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Like the ones couples have?
If you're not into it, we could look into buying starfish plushies or something similar.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I didn't say I didn't like it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Keychains are nice and small. Hardly harmful.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I think that wouldn't be a bad start.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: If we notice any positive developments because of it,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: we can progress to plushies.
You're so motivated.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I just think

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: it's a solid idea.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Every time I start getting freaked out over a starfish,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can look at that keychain

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and use it to reassure myself everything is fine.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Whenever you've got time,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: go ahead and send me one of those keychains or plushies.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll repay you as soon as I can.
Don't worry, consider it a gift.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: if you insist, then thanks.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll be looking forward to getting your present then.
I've got some online shopping to do.
